claims.claim_text: Timer text switches to text-destructive animate-pulse when timeRemaining <= 10 (HUD.tsx lines 74-77).
claims.interpretation: Last-10-second visual cue.

claims.claim_text: WALK_ANIMATION_CLASS = 'enemy-walk' and DEATH_ANIMATION_CLASS = 'enemy-die' select CSS animations per missile state (Enemy.tsx lines 10-13).
claims.interpretation: Animation classes referenced from CSS keyframes (global stylesheet not in denominator).

claims.claim_text: Enemy motion animates top: 30% -> 100% during 'falling' state, with onAnimationComplete invoking onReachBottom(id); in 'dying' state it animates rotate: 180 and triggers onDeathComplete (Enemy.tsx lines 31-49).
claims.interpretation: Linear fall to targetX at 100%, linear death-rotate.

claims.claim_text: ResultsScreen shows score / accuracy / xp / missedWords and Try Again + Leaderboard buttons (ResultsScreen.tsx lines 1-50).
claims.interpretation: Three-stat grid (Trophy/Target/Zap) + missed-words list + try-again + leaderboard.

claims.claim_text: StartScreen renders difficulty selector (easy/normal/hard/extreme with Shield/Swords/Flame/Skull icons) and a vocabulary preview of up to 50 items (StartScreen.tsx lines 1-100).
claims.interpretation: Note: StartScreen uses 'normal' rather than 'medium' for the difficulty id (the RankingDialog in the same host uses 'medium' as the canonical tab value).

claims.claim_text: StartScreen vocabulary preview caps at 50 items via .slice(0, 50) (StartScreen.tsx lines 178-198).
claims.interpretation: First 50 vocabulary entries are shown on the start screen.

claims.claim_text: RankingDialog has difficulty tabs 'easy' | 'medium' | 'hard' | 'extreme' (note: 'medium', not 'normal') (RankingDialog.tsx lines 17-21).
claims.interpretation: Local TabDifficulty type uses 'medium' (canonical server-contract value), distinct from the Difficulty store-side union that retains 'normal'.

claims.claim_text: GameContainer wraps a 560/600-tall card with status-driven screen switching idle->StartScreen, playing->GameEngine, game-over->ResultsScreen, and overlays RankingDialog on demand (GameContainer.tsx lines 1-89).
claims.interpretation: Card height 560 (mobile) / 600 (sm+) -- h-[560px] sm:h-[600px] on the wrapper div (line 53).

claims.claim_text: Status transition idle -> playing is triggered by StartScreen handleStart() -> resetGame() (GameContainer.tsx lines 39-42; useGameStore.ts lines 46-55).
claims.interpretation: Start button calls handleStart(selectedDifficulty) which sets local difficulty state then invokes resetGame() from the store; resetGame sets status='playing' and resets all counters.

claims.claim_text: Status transition playing -> game-over via damageCastle occurs when all three castles have HP=0 (useGameStore.ts lines 81-92).
claims.interpretation: Confirmed by useGameStore.test.ts (MD-TEST-007) which sequences damageCastle 9 times across all 3 castles.

claims.claim_text: Status transition playing -> game-over via timer occurs when timeRemaining reaches 0 (GameEngine.tsx lines 160-167).
claims.interpretation: endGame() reducer sets status='game-over'.

claims.claim_text: ActiveMissile state transition falling -> targeted is triggered by checkAnswer() on correct match (GameEngine.tsx lines 343-352).
claims.interpretation: On correct match, missile state is set to 'targeted' so the bolt can travel to it; spawnMissile continues targeting other missiles.

claims.claim_text: ActiveMissile state transition targeted -> dying occurs in handleBoltComplete when the bolt reaches the enemy (GameEngine.tsx lines 313-325).
claims.interpretation: Bolt completion triggers an explosion at the enemy and a dying-state animation; Enemy.onAnimationComplete fires onDeathComplete(id).

claims.claim_text: Status reset (game-over -> idle) happens via resetGame which clears score/castles/status=playing (useGameStore.ts lines 46-55). The ResultsScreen onRestart prop wires to resetGame (ResultsScreen.tsx lines 18-19).
claims.interpretation: ResultsScreen's Try Again button calls onRestart which is resetGame; the user re-enters playing state with fresh castle HP and counters.

claims.claim_text: GameEngine detects mobile via navigator.maxTouchPoints > 0 || 'ontouchstart' in window and stores the boolean in state (GameEngine.tsx lines 120-130).
claims.interpretation: isMobile flag is the source for the bottom-pinned mobile input bar and the floating Ultimate! button.

claims.claim_text: InputController renders a mobile bottom-pinned input bar (mobile=true branch) with rounded-xl + bg-slate-950/90 backdrop-blur (InputController.tsx lines 60-104).
claims.interpretation: Mobile input is fully visible with SendHorizonal submit button; differs from desktop's invisible keyboard input.

claims.claim_text: InputController renders an invisible desktop keyboard input (mobile=false branch) auto-focused via window click listener (InputController.tsx lines 105-176).
claims.interpretation: Desktop keeps focus on the hidden input so typing triggers handleSubmit without manual click; magic-bolt travels from caster to typed enemy.

claims.claim_text: HUD uses 'sm:' Tailwind prefixes for text-xl->text-2xl and px-3->px-5 widths, line-height, and timer font scale (HUD.tsx lines 18-58).
claims.interpretation: Score/accuracy HUD uses text-xl sm:text-2xl; mana bar uses w-24 sm:w-64; compact-width renders at 24px wide, sm+ at 256px.

claims.claim_text: GameContainer sets h-[560px] sm:h-[600px] on the wrapper div and overflow-hidden rounded-lg border (GameContainer.tsx line 53).
claims.interpretation: Single breakpoint (sm+) increases card height by 40px to give extra room on tablet/desktop viewports.

claims.claim_text: FIXTURE (must FAIL): 'magic-defense' grants a 2x XP multiplier on extreme-difficulty victories via the reading-advantage MagicDefenseController.completeGame handler.
claims.interpretation: expected_disposition=FAIL. controller.ts lines 48-60 show xpEarned = Math.floor(correctAnswers * accuracy) with NO difficulty multiplier; the difficulty field is only used to write to gameRankings table. advantage-games page.tsx line 61 reproduces the same formula. No multiplier branch exists.

claims.claim_text: FIXTURE (must be REJECTED): 'magic-defense' is implemented as a single shared /games/_shared/defense-template.tsx renderer that all action-defense games (castle-defense, magic-defense, wizard-vs-zombie, village-guardian) share verbatim.
claims.interpretation: expected_disposition=REJECT. Directory-only claim with no file path/line/hash. Mechanical absence check confirms NO 'defense-template.tsx' file exists under apps/advantage-games/src/components/games/_shared/ or anywhere in the repo. Castle-Defense has its own CastleDefenseGame.tsx (per T2 phase3 scene_records); wizard-vs-zombie has WizardZombieGame.tsx; village-guardian uses VillageGuardian.ts. Magic Defense uses the SHARED game/Enemy.tsx + game/GameEngine.tsx but those are not generic defense templates -- they are configured per game via magicDefenseConfig.ts.

claims.claim_text: FIXTURE (must be REJECTED): 'magic-defense' uses a regex-keyword responsive template -- 'if (window.matchMedia('(max-width: 768px)').matches) { ... }' -- to switch between compact and wide layouts.
claims.interpretation: expected_disposition=REJECT. Mechanical absence check: the substring 'matchMedia' does NOT appear anywhere in GameEngine.tsx, magicDefenseConfig.ts, Enemy.tsx, GameContainer.tsx, StartScreen.tsx, ResultsScreen.tsx, HUD.tsx, InputController.tsx, MagicBolt.tsx, Explosion.tsx, RankingDialog.tsx, or useGameStore.ts. The only mobile detection is the navigator.maxTouchPoints / 'ontouchstart' in window check at GameEngine.tsx:124-128, which is a touch-capability probe, not a regex matchMedia pattern. Layout responsive behavior is provided exclusively through Tailwind sm:/lg: classes (e.g., GameContainer.tsx line 53 h-[560px] sm:h-[600px]; HUD.tsx sm:text-2xl).

claims.claim_text: FIXTURE (must be REJECTED): All magic-defense sprite sheets live under apps/advantage-games/public/games/magic-defense/.
claims.interpretation: expected_disposition=REJECT. Directory-only citation (file_path ends with '/' and no line range / hash) is a validation failure per the claim-evidence contract, regardless of whether the directory statement happens to be true. Per T2 asset-file-denominator, three sprite files are enumerated under the directory (background.png, castles_3x2_sheet.png, skeletons_3x3_pose_sheet.png) and the cover lives at apps/advantage-games/public/games/cover/magic-defense-cover.png (one level up, not in the directory).

claims.claim_text: FIXTURE (must be REJECTED): The reading-advantage MagicDefenseController writes the game completion to a Redis sorted-set keyed 'leaderboard:magic-defense:{difficulty}' so rankings can be queried in O(log N) time.
claims.interpretation: expected_disposition=REJECT. The ranking storage is a Postgres gameRankings table (lines 90-100 of magic-defense-controller.ts) with onConflictDoUpdate semantics, NOT a Redis sorted-set. The getRanking handler (lines 122-180) does a Postgres SELECT joining gameRankings + users. No 'Redis', 'zadd', 'sorted-set', or similar identifiers appear in the controller source. Plausible-sounding infra claim with zero source backing; rejected on absence-of-evidence grounds.
